# Repository instructions

This is a public support/knowledge repository, not product source code. Read AGENTS.md first. Preserve the public/private evidence boundary, stable problem IDs, source hierarchy, verification requirements, and canonical-website role. Do not invent product capabilities or provider behavior. Never add secrets, private account evidence, customer/order data, private logs, internal paths, or proprietary source code. Prefer updating the ontology/source record rather than creating inconsistent duplicate facts.
